name: Cafe Rosengartl
kurzbeschreibung: Café Rosengartl in Imst Discover the cozy charm of Café Rosengartl in the heart of Imst, where traditional Tyrolean hospitality meets a delightful selection of homemade pastries…
beschreibung: The Cafe Rosengartl in Imst is an inviting café that treats guests to homemade pastries, artisanal coffees, and a relaxed environment. Visitors can savor traditional Austrian sweets like apple strudel and chocolate cakes, accompanied by creamy Verlängerter or Melange. Friendly staff and cozy seating make it an ideal rest stop while visiting the Imst area.
